title: Update above:Nice mat for drying pots and pans has ridge to keep from slipping down.
text:
Update above:Nice mat for drying pots and pans has ridge to keep from slipping down.. Update, I do like the idea of this silicone drying mat from keeping pots & pans etc sliding down, but it’s always wet!
Even when I use a dish towel , or sponge to try and dry it off fast.
I hand wash knife , Wooden spoons, and silicone spatulas , lay them on this mat but the mat does not absorb the water , and I do not always dry everything that is laying on a wet silicone mat, except my knifes.
Going back to My large thick material drying mats.
Going from a 5 star, to a 3 star.
———

I have a dishwasher but use a quilted drying mat for items I would not put in the dishwasher. Such as knifes
Wooden bowls, wooden spoons, all my pots and pans, plastics etc.

My husband helps me doing dishes since he has retired due to Coved.
Hubby loves this silicon drying mat, this has ridge in it that keeps your pots, pans, and lids from sliding
Down.
This mat does not absorb the water, but the water runs down on the silicon ridges.
Sometimes I take a dish towel to wipe up the water, or shake this out in the sink.

It says you can put this in the dishwasher. I’m assuming on the top rack. I have just taken my dish brush To wash
This, it’s easy.
This mat can be used to put hot food bowls on.
The mat has a ridge in it for folding to put away, or if your not using all of it, then it takes up less counter space.

product_metadata.title: Dish Drying Mat Dish Drainer Mat,Silicone Dish Drying Mat,Kitchen Sink Drying Mat,Foldable Silicone Drying Mat,Easy clean Silicone Mat for Kitchen Counter Sink Bar Bottle or Cup (Black)
